bagPolicy.summary: Bags, backpacks, luggage, or cases with dimensions exceeding 30x30x15cm are not allowed on the sites. This is to protect the frescoes and ensure visitor safety.
prohibited: Bags, backpacks, luggage, or cases exceeding 30x30x15cm
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: There is no dedicated parking area for visitors at the Archaeological Park. However, there are many municipal parking spaces available at a cost, marked by blue lines, as well as several private car parks nearby.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Anfiteatro degli Scavi's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Visitors can enjoy a variety of local and seasonal products at the 'Pizza, Pasta & More' self-service restaurant managed by CIRFOOD. The venue offers a Café & Wine Bar with charcuterie, wines, cheeses, and traditional pastries, enhancing the visitor experience with quality and local flavors.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Anfiteatro degli Scavi, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Anfiteatro degli Scavi's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Anfiteatro degli Scavi. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Anfiteatro degli Scavi. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
